verdict.rationale: AIMA is Portugal's immigration agency, a government public-service website, not an AI agent or host application that could act as an MCP client. Asking whether users can plug MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. The only evidence item is a failed TLS probe, which says nothing about MCP either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
